name: Lean Cuisine Favorites Glazed Chicken with White Rice & Green Beans
whyItWorks: One of the cleanest frozen meals in the grocery store: tender white meat chicken tenderloins in a sweet lemon-tarragon glaze, served over white rice and soft green beans. Very low in fat (under 4g) and low in sodium.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave for 4 minutes. Stir chicken and rice into the glaze before eating.
watchOuts: A gentle, low-fat frozen meal ideal for fatigue days.
